clubhouse.name: Clubhouse
clubhouse.description: The heart of every course. Guests arrive at its door, freshen up inside, and set off for the first tee. Supplied with the course; it can be moved, never demolished.

putting_green.name: Putting Green
putting_green.description: Putting Greens boost the imagination skill of golfers who visit, with a greater boost based on that golfer's imagination skill up to a max boost. Available on all locations.

snack_bar.name: Snack Bar
snack_bar.description: Snack Bars offer a place where hungry golfers may stop and eat. Available on all locations unless it uses the Links Course Theme.

pub.name: Pub
pub.description: Pubs offer a place where hungry golfers may stop and eat. Available on all locations that use the Links Course Theme.

pro_shop.name: Pro Shop
pro_shop.description: Pro Shops boost the accuracy skill of golfers who visit, with a greater boost based on that golfer's accuracy skill up to a max boost. Available on all locations.

driving_range.name: Driving Range
driving_range.description: Driving Ranges boost the length skill of golfers who visit, with a greater boost based on that golfer's length skill up to a max boost. Available on all locations.

cart_garage.name: Cart Garage
cart_garage.description: Cart Garages boost the walking speed of golfers who visit. Available on all locations.

tennis_court.name: Tennis Court
tennis_court.description: Owning a Tennis Court starts every golfer with a more positive attitude before playing your course. Available on all locations unless it uses the Links, Desert, or Tropical Course Themes.

stable.name: Stable
stable.description: Owning a Stable starts every golfer with a more positive attitude before playing your course. Available on all locations that use the Links Course Theme.

spa.name: Spa
spa.description: Owning a Spa starts every golfer with a more positive attitude before playing your course. Available on all locations that use the Desert Course Theme.

swim_club.name: Swim Club
swim_club.description: Owning a Swim Club starts every golfer with a more positive attitude before playing your course. Available on all locations that use the Tropical Course Theme.

resort_hotel.name: Resort Hotel
resort_hotel.description: Owning a Resort Hotel starts every golfer with more stamina before playing your course. At higher levels of difficulty, golfers tire as they play through a course and may need to combat the fatigue of playing to stay happier longer. Available on all locations.

airstrip.name: Airstrip
airstrip.description: Owning an Airstrip boosts green fees per hole, with a greater boost based on that hole's rating. Available on all locations unless it uses the Links, Desert, or Tropical Course Themes.

castle.name: Castle
castle.description: Owning a Castle boosts green fees per hole, with a greater boost based on that hole's rating. Available on all locations that use the Links Course Theme.

casino.name: Casino
casino.description: Owning a Casino boosts green fees per hole, with a greater boost based on that hole's rating. Available on all locations that use the Desert Course Theme.

theme_park.name: Theme Park
theme_park.description: Owning a Theme Park boosts green fees per hole, with a greater boost based on that hole's rating. Available on all locations that use the Tropical Course Theme.
